testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open temporary ribbon commands using a tab key tip ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active ✔ When the user presses Alt ✔ Then key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls ✔ And the 3D Model tab displays the key tip "M" ✔ When the user presses "M" ✔ Then the temporary 3D Model command area opens ✔ And command key tips are visible ✔ When the user presses Alt ✔ Then the key tips disappear ✔ And the temporary 3D Model command area remains visible ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the temporary command area closes and the ribbon remains minimized to tabs ✔ When the user double-clicks the 3D Model tab ✔ Then the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
